attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 1778820)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Tekken_8
Fandom (tekken.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://tekken.fandom.com/wiki/Tekken_8
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). Chapters follow the game modes the achievements name. StrategyWiki has the guide at completion stage 1, but no walkthrough is written: of its subpages only "Moves" (about 42,700 characters), "Achievements and trophies" (about 7,500) and "Table of Contents" exist as real pages, while "Walkthrough" and "Gameplay" are short redirects to the series pages "Tekken/Walkthrough" and "Tekken/Gameplay", and "The Dark Awakens" and "Tekken Ball" subpages are linked but not created. So it was not recorded in sw-structure.json and swUsed is off. tekken.fandom.com answers the API under "Tekken 8", with about 233 linked pages (characters, moves, stages such as "Celebration on the Seine" and "Coliseum of Fate", and modes such as "Arcade Quest"); names only were looked at, nothing copied. Steam app 1778820. 10 of 47 Steam achievements are hidden; they sit in The Dark Awakens chapter as a placeholder, though "Congrats on the victory!", "A new star rising in the world of TEKKEN!" and "Get ready for the next battle!" may belong to other modes. The rank promotion achievements (Brawler, Warrior, Vanquisher) do not say whether they need online play; they sit in the online chapter. Most technique achievements exclude offline player battles. Online chapters need a network connection.
